# ai-theories

> Open-source projects published at ai-theories.github.io.

## Projects

- [Wealth Skills](https://ai-theories.github.io/wealth-skills/llms.txt): wealth skills and investing skills for Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Claude skills (SKILL.md packs) for wealth management, zero-dependency calculation engines, a CLI and MCP servers for tax, portfolios, compliance and fund operations.
- [Wealth Skills full documentation](https://ai-theories.github.io/wealth-skills/llms-full.txt): the README and every skill pack in one file.
- [Wealth Skills source code](https://github.com/ai-theories/wealth-skills)
- [Tax Skills](https://ai-theories.github.io/tax-skills/llms.txt): Claude skills for US investment tax analysis. Lot-level gain and loss, wash-sale screening across accounts and UMA sleeves, loss harvesting and rebalancing under a gain budget, municipal bond pricing, and federal estimates, computed by a deterministic Python engine behind nine MCP servers with versioned rule packs.
- [Tax Skills full documentation](https://ai-theories.github.io/tax-skills/llms-full.txt): the README and every skill in one file.
- [Tax Skills tested cases](https://ai-theories.github.io/tax-skills/cases.html): all 301 scripted cases, grouped by client objective.
- [Tax Skills source code](https://github.com/ai-theories/tax-skills)
